review.selectedNextStep: Reuse the actual rationalEval already used for cover reciprocity. Adapt the existing cusp proof that positive order of a function minus its normal-form value identifies its residue. The constructed cover family then has genuinely meromorphic residue-evaluation functions with exact orders and an analytic uniformizer coordinate. Shrink using the pinned analytic inverse-function theorem to obtain an injective chart.
review.shorterRouteAssessment: No new evaluation, residue field or function-field model is required. The actual finite-cover residue bijection is already proved. The existing original cusp proof is field-independent after those inputs, so expose just those parameters and instantiate the literal Kummer cover.

review.discharged: Every actual place of the literal original complex torsion cover has an injective local parameter family centered at that place. The genuine rational residue evaluation of its uniformizer equals the parameter. All nonzero field-element readings are meromorphic with their exact normalized place orders, and regular readings are analytic. The proof consumes the native cover residue bijection, the constructed place family, equality of residue and analytic normal-form values, and the pinned analytic inverse-function theorem.
